description: Set or clear a member's server nickname. Pass null (or the string 'null') to clear it. Requires the Manage Nicknames permission (or Change Nickname for the bot itself). The reason is recorded in the audit log.

nickname.description: New nickname (max 32 characters), or null to clear it.

reason.description: Optional reason recorded in the server audit log.

user_id.description: Discord user ID (snowflake) of the member.

name: discord_set_nickname
